tools.description: Turn an EVENT, news prompt, or article URL into a ready-to-build Event Card basket: runs the Tuatara Vector Model to find connected stocks AND cryptos, then marks which suggestions are tradable on the platform (same pricing check as preview_card_basket). Call this FIRST when building a card from a theme or link, then refine with preview_card_basket and launch with build_custom_event_card.

event.description: The event, prompt, headline, or theme to analyze — may be or contain a URL (the linked article's content is analyzed).

tools.name: suggest_card_assets
tools.title: Suggest Card Assets

tools.description: Launch a custom Event Card from an explicit asset list — the agent equivalent of the /events/builder page. Give it a title, 3-12 tickers (validate each with preview_card_basket first), optional per-symbol weights (default equal-weight; renormalized server-side) and whether to publish on the public leaderboard. The card goes live immediately, attributed to YOUR linked platform account, and its EVCDX index token deploys automatically. Charges the one-time card creation fee (USDC) to the linked balance when the fee is non-zero — errors with CREATION_FEE_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE otherwise. Subject to the daily per-user card limit and content moderation.

publish_to_leaderboard.description: true (DEFAULT) = card shows on the public leaderboard; false = private (direct link only)

symbols.description: 3-12 unique tickers (crypto or stocks) forming the basket

title.description: Card name (3-240 chars), e.g. 'FOMC — Crypto Reaction, Sep 16 2026'

weights.description: Optional weights keyed by symbol (e.g. {'ETH': 0.6, 'BTC': 0.4}); renormalized to sum to 1. Omit for equal weighting.

tools.name: build_custom_event_card
tools.title: Build Custom Event Card

tools.description: Clone an AI trading bot into YOUR linked account. PAPER by default (paper=true): no real funds move, the clone trades the account's simulated balance. The clone starts PAUSED with a 0 balance — then call fund_clone_bot and toggle_bot_trading(enabled=true). Live clones (explicit paper=false) pass the platform trading gate. REST twin: POST /api/v1/cloned-bots/clone.

custom_name.description: Optional display name for the clone (max 100 chars)

paper.description: true (DEFAULT) = paper clone, simulated funds. false = live clone, real USDC, gated.

source_id.description: The bot id to clone (from list_clonable_bots)

tools.name: clone_bot
tools.title: Clone Bot

tools.description: List the bots YOU have cloned (instance_id, name, is_paper, is_trading, balance, P&L). Filter with mode=paper|live. REST twin: GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/my-clones.
tools.name: get_my_clones
tools.title: Get My Clones

tools.description: Move USDC into one of YOUR clones' isolated bot balance. For a PAPER clone the amount comes from your SIMULATED balance (sim_balance_usdc) — your real USDC balance never moves. For a LIVE clone it comes from your real internal USDC balance (platform trading gate applies). REST twin: POST /api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/fund.

amount.description: USDC amount to transfer into the bot (> 0)

tools.name: fund_clone_bot
tools.title: Fund Clone Bot

tools.description: Read one of YOUR clones' balance: available, locked in open trades, total, is_paper. REST twin: GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/balance.
tools.name: get_clone_balance
tools.title: Get Clone Balance

tools.description: Start (enabled=true) or pause (enabled=false) one of YOUR clones. A fresh clone starts PAUSED — this is how an agent enables it. Paper clones have no minimum balance; a LIVE clone needs >= $10 USDC in the bot and passes the platform trading gate. Pausing keeps open positions. REST twin: POST /api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/toggle-trading?enabled=true.
tools.name: toggle_bot_trading
tools.title: Toggle Bot Trading

tools.description: Change one of YOUR clones' trading settings — is_trading (start/pause), event_card_trading_enabled + event_card_filters (trade event cards), arena_trading_enabled, catalog_trading_enabled + catalog_watchlist, tge_trading_enabled, stop_loss_pct (1-20), take_profit_pct (5-100), max_position_pct (1-50), max_open_positions, min_ai_confidence, min_volume_24h_usd, name. Same fields and bounds as the REST twin PATCH /api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/settings; unknown fields are rejected by name.

event_card_filters.description: max_position_usdc, min_abs_sentiment, min_impact_score, direction_override, take_profit_pct, stop_loss_pct

event_card_trading_enabled.description: Let the bot trade LIVE event cards (EVCDX-*)

tools.name: update_bot_settings
tools.title: Update Bot Settings

tools.description: Read one of YOUR clones' technical-indicator parameters (species defaults + your overrides).

tools.description: Override one indicator's parameters on one of YOUR clones (rsi/macd/ema/sma/bollinger/atr/stochastic), e.g. indicator_name='rsi', params={'period': 21}.

indicator_name.description: rsi | macd | ema | sma | bollinger | atr | stochastic

tools.description: Create your own custom AIB fund (real money: the creation fee is charged from your agent account's USDC balance). The Tuatara vector model builds the basket from your theme prompts; the fund goes live with an index, custody and a tradable pair under Tuatara Hedge Fund management.

direction.description: long | short (crypto funds only; default long)

prompts.description: 1-5 short theme prompts (singular terms read best)

public.description: List in Community AIB Funds (default false via MCP)

tools.name: create_aib_fund
tools.title: Create AIB Fund

tools.description: List the custom AIB funds your agent account owns, plus builder limits and the current creation fee.
tools.name: list_my_aib_funds
tools.title: List My AIB Funds

tools.description: Modify a self-directed fund you own: atomically replace its membership with a new full leg set (index continuity preserved). Only the owner may edit; theme funds keep their approval flow.

legs.description: Full new leg set: [{symbol, asset_class, weight?}] (weight = percent, target mode)

weighting.description: 'price' | 'equal' | 'target'; omit to keep the fund's current mode

weights.description: {SYMBOL: percent} for target mode (alternative to per-leg weight)

tools.name: edit_aib_fund_basket
tools.title: Edit AIB Fund Basket

tools.description: Set the weights of a self-directed fund you own — your own percentages for every leg ('target'), equal ('equal'), or one share per asset ('price'). Membership is untouched; every leg is re-marked live so the index and share price continue unbroken, and the fund's real-share backing follows the new weights. Stock legs need live prices (US market hours).

weights.description: {SYMBOL: percent} covering EVERY leg, summing to 100 (target mode)

tools.name: set_aib_fund_weights
tools.title: Set AIB Fund Weights
